automatable_note: A jumper must be fitted on two of the three programming contacts before power is applied and pulled off after the ESC's first tone sequence. The bench has no actuator for the jumper, so a person performs both steps.

manual.action: Fit the jumper on any 2 of the 3 programming contacts.
manual.action_de: Jumper auf 2 beliebige der 3 Programmierkontakte stecken.

manual.action: Pull the jumper off after 2 s or the tone sequence.
manual.action_de: Jumper nach 2 s oder der Tonfolge abziehen.

manual.action: Hands off: wait until the ESC has finished repeating the mode (tones), then tap DONE.
manual.action_de: Nicht berühren: warten, bis der ESC den Modus fertig wiederholt hat (Töne), dann ERLEDIGT tippen.

entry.confirm_signal: Tone sequence after the 2 s wait.
steps: Operator: fit the jumper on any 2 of the 3 programming contacts. Connect the motor if tones are to be audible.
Transmitter and receiver on. Throttle to brake (stick back) for modes 1, 2 and 5; to motor-off (stick back) for modes 3, 4 and 7; to motor-off (stick middle) for modes 6 and 8.
Wait 2 s or until the ESC sounds its tone sequence.
The ESC sounds the mode series. Mode 7 is reached by waiting for the 7-fold signal.
Move the throttle to full (stick forward) when the wanted mode sounds. Mode 6: then stick to brake (back). Mode 8: then stick to full reverse (back).
Control output: the ESC repeats the mode. Disconnect power.

announce.description: The ESC sounds mode 1 as one tone, mode 2 as two tones, and so on, one series after another with a pause between series.

select.description: Move the throttle to full when the wanted mode sounds.

scheme.confirm_signal: Control output: the mode is repeated as tones.
scheme.reset_to_defaults: Program mode 1 (APM); it clears all settings.
scheme.description: Jumper procedure with a 2 s wait. Mode N is N tones. The FAI and CAR models use a different menu in their addenda and have their own profiles.

values.name: APM: reset, stick range learned at every power-up
Glider: brake about 0.5 s, cutoff 0.8 V per cell, optional separate motor-off position
Motor plane / boat: brake off, cutoff off
Competition F5B / F5B 10 cells / F5D: maximum brake, cutoff off
Reverse motor rotation (needs a mode other than 1 programmed first)

unknowns: Duration of one tone in ms is not stated.
Gap between tones inside one mode series in ms is not stated.
Pause between two mode series in ms is not stated.
Whether the mode series loops until a mode is selected is not stated.
Time window in ms for moving the throttle to full after the wanted series is not stated.
Duration in ms of the three-tone sequences (ascending and descending) is not stated.
Exact timing of the 'wait 2 s or until the tone sequence' step is not stated beyond the 2 s minimum; the end of the wait is the ESC's tone sequence.
Cell counts are NiCd cells; voltage in mV is not stated.
BEC type of the 6-12 cell models is not stated beyond 'with BEC'.
Tone sequence symbols are not readable in the PDF text; the 'or until' event is a pictogram.
notes: The Beat manual lists FAI models (FAI 7/10, FAI 24, FAI 27) with this procedure; their addendum Kontronik_Beat_FAI.pdf replaces the menu, see kontronik-beat-fai.
The ESC may only be fed from NiCd or NiMH packs per the manual's safety text.

Modes 6 and 8 are programmed with the stick at motor-off in the middle (Kontronik_Beat.pdf p.15, p.17 DE; p.37, p.39 EN). They carry entry_throttle mid, so stick programming does not store them from the brake position.

Mode 6 moves the stick to the brake position and mode 8 to full reverse, both back, after the full-throttle selection (Kontronik_Beat.pdf p.15, p.17 DE; p.37, p.39 EN): after_select min, made STORE after the selection; the manual gives no time.

After the store the ESC repeats the stored mode as tones (control output, 'Kontrollausgabe'), and the manual disconnects power after it (Kontronik_Beat.pdf p.5-15 (DE)). The step before_power_off holds the run powered until the operator taps DONE. The manual names no lock for a power-off before the end of it.
